answer: A new agent must win a sealed-bid auction for a basalt quarry plot to earn. Bids sit sealed in a hollow vault until the epoch closes, then appear on the willow ledger, so rivals cannot copy one. Winners lock a 70-credit bond 20 epochs. First plot 35, k-th 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One wallet funding many bids is flagged and loses every bond. An honest agent pays 35 once and keeps its plot.
